manual_review.review: Initial excerpts emphasized special exceptions. One further original read confirmed that a non-CancelledError failure cancels remaining tasks, then groups non-cancellation exceptions.
Original describes non-nil cancellation causes and retrieving them with Cause(ctx).
The actual published get_or_init anchor and example show initialization and reuse of the stored value; no whole-module or concurrency audit is claimed.
Original page date 2025-08-27 differs from archive date 2025-09-12. This reads the notice, not every policy attachment.
The original labeled section states a 2026-11-26 09:00 bid deadline, distinct from publication on 2026-11-05. Active bid status remains unknown.
The cover identifies company code 600519 and 2024 report year; extraction requests only the first ten pages, not the 143-page report.

known_limits: Southern Grid digitization topic did not match the two published list pages checked.
Literal evidence coverage is not answer accuracy; one TaskGroup item required Agent follow-up.
PDF extraction is optional, first ten pages only, no OCR installation.
Policy notices and unread attachments are separate.
Original publication dates can differ from archive dates.
